name: 05-queue-bay
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: buildable Blender-to-Roblox environment concept, revised LEVEL 3 loading/queue bay in BACKROOMS: STAY QUIET.
Input reference1 is the freshly generated and USER-APPROVED Level3 gate style: weathered mustard-yellow concrete, chunky bolted black metal doorframe, readable LEVEL 3 lintel above the side doorway, perpendicular projecting horizontal LEVEL 3 → blade sign visible down the tunnel, restrained cyan light strips. Retain this same architecture and level of game-art craft. Input reference2 is the REAL current Level3 lobby bay geometry: a broad orange 90s children's-party/backrooms room off the tunnel with multiple circular launch pads. Improve its loading-bay art while retaining the roomy side-room layout and pad circulation.
Primary scene: one wide16:9 image, eye-level diagonally looking through the Level3 gate INTO the queue bay, with the LEVEL 3 header and projecting arrow sign both visible in the left/foreground, the main tunnel sidewalk still clear and the room beyond framed by the gate. No fake HUD, title overlay or watermark.
Show a beautiful detailed but grounded queue bay: aged saturated burnt-orange wall panels, worn muted party-pattern carpet inset around thick black circular launch plinths, matching industrial cyan details, modest readable station displays. Three or four separated queue pads with generous walking space; no clutter blocking entrances, not a military loading dock. 90s institutional/backrooms feel, not a sterile sci-fi facility.
One prominent occupied queue pad has JUST STARTED a queue: a crisp thin cyan hologram ring glowing around its floor perimeter, from which a TRANSLUCENT VERTICAL CYLINDER OF LIGHT rises roughly chest-to-head height. The cylinder wall is brightest at its bottom edge and smoothly FADES UPWARD TO COMPLETE TRANSPARENCY, with a very faint scan-line texture. It is hollow, you can clearly see the room and two simple friendly Roblox-blocky avatar silhouettes through it. No opaque top lid, no solid wall, no closed cage, no forcefield sphere, no thick spiraling beams, no lasers. The top boundary dissolves softly rather than forming another hard ring. Show the fade gradient unmistakably. Low bloom, no flashing or heavy particles; warm room materials stay visible around and through the effect. The avatars serve only to communicate scale/queue, neutral simple clothes, no detailed faces or horror character.
Other pads are EMPTY / INACTIVE: only a dim floor-ring outline, absolutely no raised cylinder. One small physical station sign near the active pad can read QUEUE ACTIVE, with clean understated type; no unrelated invented game data, counters or prices. Match the approved gate's game art, strongly readable silhouettes, local cyan floor reflection, attractive controlled lighting. Preserve distinct normal architecture and holographic queue effect. All pads are walk-through, no decorative barrier across the central route. No water, sky, rainbow RGB, smoke, nightclub décor, gore, brand names.
refinement: Owner approved lintel plus projecting arrow gate. Owner requested active-queue floor ring raising a translucent cylinder that fades upward.
